obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional source relation; exact algebra only over explicitly admitted abstract domains
obernants.assumptions: Fixed corpus/metadata, canonical coherent lemma extension, valid acyclic ancestry, complete delta writes, successful reads/indexing, immutable indexes and truthful saved stamps. For chains, each edge needs these conditions. Sample/prefix coupling is handled by reselection, not this pointwise law.
obernants.domain: Finite valid records, tables and ID sets; specialized in operator
obernants.observation_scope: One identity, feature or pointwise carry transition
obernants.operator: Universe: admitted pointwise-query transitions satisfying the listed conditions, paired with returned membership. Complement excludes a changed membership outside C and a carried set different from fresh selection. Without delta completeness or table preservation these exclusions are not established.

obernants.observation_scope: One identity, feature or pointwise carry transition
obernants.operator: For fresh F, changed C and carried Y, compatible predecessors O satisfy O outside C = Y outside C and F inside C = Y inside C. Correctness Y=F further requires O outside C=F outside C. Prior membership within C is unconstrained; neither old tags nor old lemma values can be reconstructed from the ID set.

obernants.observation_scope: One identity, feature or pointwise carry transition
obernants.operator: On each edge, identity outside its delta implies feature equality there. For an ID outside the union C, edge equality composes transitively, giving endpoint feature equality and pointwise membership equality. A tag-only delta may enlarge C while preserving features. A lemma-only subject change must enter C when normalized strings differ.

obernants.operator: update continues after text or parent-record read errors; index_full skips failed tree reads. Same-hash early return performs no comparison. Invalid/sparse tables, mutation under a fixed hash and a forged stable stamp can violate premises. The helper repair and synthetic index/carry tests do not verify whole update or remove these boundaries.
